LBR.note: Procurement notice; states no rule or authority on AI harms.
The AI system is for climate services, a sectoral system, not general administration.

facts.fact: Liberia's Environmental Protection Agency, in a notice issued 6 April 2026, seeks a consultant to design and develop a cloud-based Automated Decision Management System using AI and ML to forecast floods, droughts and extreme weather and generate alerts, with an MVP in pilot counties before a rollout to all 15 counties.
facts.system: Automated Decision Management System (ADMS), Liberia Climate Information System Project

facts.fact: The Environmental Protection Agency's 6 April 2026 notice says an AI and ML based cloud Automated Decision Management System is to be developed in Liberia, funded by the Green Climate Fund, AfDB and the Government of Liberia (US$11,431,969 project), for a 16-week consultancy from 20 April 2026.
